lessons: merge-queue needs a criterion: tests/test_mergequeue.py proves dormancy with the 19.L import-closure scan from chupa/__main__.py. The scan handles both `import chupa.x` and `from chupa import x`, and fails if chupa.mergequeue is reachable, including through merge.py.

Add a real-repo test: after every rung refusal (mechanical refuses, strategy undeclared, both refuse) the worktree is not mid-rebase, HEAD equals the pre-admission head, and `status --porcelain` is empty. Say whether a public rebase_abort counts in the three-op allowlist.

State the section 9 semantics with tests. Red-streak pauses at K=3 consecutive distinct tickets (say where K comes from). The same ticket going red twice does not trip it. A tree-hash mismatch escalates and never journals `to: merged`.

Specify both rungs. Rung 1 is git merge plus only the declared merge.strategies from chupa/config.py, failing closed on undeclared paths. Rung 2 returns a named typed unresolved-conflict handoff (paths, stem) and never calls Rework inline. Test that each case picks the right rung.

State what merge.py owns, e.g. reuse of the gate tuples with no change to merge() signature or behavior. List tests/test_merge.py and tests/test_shakeout.py as preservation suites. Then update test_seeded_phase3_01.py pins and re-measure render sizes.
